question: Where and with what formula is the pa-class syllable group assigned to Kubera?
premises: The pa-class-beginning syllable is directed to Kubera.
The placement is in the right hand.
inference: The pa-class syllable group is installed in the right hand with the obeisance formula addressed to Kubera.
plain_english: Place the syllables beginning with the pa class in the right hand with the formula: obeisance indeed to Kubera.
